theme.strategy: Dual emotional design: Public & Student portal uses an authentic Indian institutional civic pride palette (Deep Navy Blue #0F172A, NSS Rath Wheel Crimson Red #DC2626 / #B91C1C, Warm Sand/Parchment #F8FAFC and #FFFDF7, Crisp White, and Gold accents #D97706) honoring the NSS motto 'NOT ME BUT YOU'. Admin & Super Admin portal uses a high-clarity command center (Slate-900 sidebar, dense 1px zinc/slate borders, clear tabular layout, zero fluff).

brand_assets.header_order_rule: MANDATORY: User strictly specified: 'keep NSS logo first and beside that keep NMAMIT logo'. The header branding must display the circular NSS logo on the left, followed immediately by the NMAMIT / Nitte logo on the right, accompanied by clear typography 'NSS UNIT - NMAMIT' and subline 'Nitte (Deemed to be University)'.

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

rules.eyebrow_labels: text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-red-600 dark:text-red-400
rules.no_banned_defaults_for_headers: Do NOT use plain generic sans without tracking or bold character. Avoid generic AI slop.

event_card.pattern: High visual hierarchy card with status badge, date badge, capacity bar, Razorpay fee chip (Free / ₹XX), location, and quick registration button.
event_card.registration_modal: Includes volunteer details, emergency contact, Terms & Conditions checkbox, Razorpay mock checkout trigger, and instant downloadable invoice simulation.

views: Registered events with admission pass QR
Attendance ledger with calculated service hours (NSS 120 hr requirement tracker)
Payment invoices with PDF download simulation
Social profile links & volunteer badge level

gallery_system.photo_frame_feature: Interactive Photo Frame generator allowing volunteers to preview their event memory in an official 'NSS NMAMIT Volunteer' commemorative frame with date stamp and download button.
gallery_system.slideshow_lightbox: Smooth modal slideshow with keyboard navigation and drive links.

accounts_ledger.pattern: Full financial ledger recording event registration fees, donations, equipment expenses, refreshments, certificate printing costs, and balance summary.

certificate_verification.features: Direct search by certificate number (e.g. NSS-NMAMIT-2025-0842), displaying student USN, event name, issue date, verified signature seal, and tamper-proof stamp.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Always maintain NSS logo FIRST and NMAMIT logo BESIDE IT in header, hero, footer, and certificates as explicitly instructed.
Do NOT use pure black #000000 or sterile generic grays; use slate/zinc tinted neutrals.
Header must have solid or heavy backdrop-blur background (bg-white/95 or bg-slate-900/95); NEVER transparent over text.
Every interactive button, input, tab, modal, and link MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='event-card-register-btn', data-testid='member-login-submit').

Include pre-seeded sample data for all 3 experiences (Public visitors, Student Volunteer, Admin Officer, Super Admin) with a 1-click 'Demo Account Switcher' or test credentials banner for effortless evaluation.
Provide responsive drawer / mobile navigation for mobile screens, keeping desktop navbar clear and expansive.
Use Sonner for toasts (registration confirmation, invoice download, certificate verification, admin CRUD).
All components should be standard React .js or .jsx as configured in package.json.
